summary: Frontend-only i18n date formatting verification across Dashboard, BookingDetail, Admin tabs, and Messages. All 10 review checkpoints PASSED. No raw YYYY-MM-DD strings shown to user in any localized surface; Intl.DateTimeFormat range output exactly matches the spec for EN/FR/ES across single-day and multi-day bookings.

verification_evidence.messages_fr_chat_timestamp: 22:08 (24h, no AM/PM) — correctly localized for fr-FR
verification_evidence.regression_lang_switching: Verified: header text in ES ('Bienvenido, Marcus', 'Publicar herramienta'), FR ('Tableau de bord', 'Publier un outil'), EN ('Welcome, Marcus') all translate. No console errors observed.
verification_evidence.regression_toolcard_distance: No occurrences of 'X km away' text found on /browse — 'away' word removed as expected.

minor_observations: Admin Email log entries contain raw ISO YYYY-MM-DD inside the email body text (e.g. 'tanzila rahman requested 20V Drill from 2026-06-22 to 2026-06-24'). This is the server-generated email message body content, not the display timestamp — out of scope for this i18n iteration which targets UI date formatting only. The actual 'sent_at' timestamp in the row is correctly localized via formatDateTime ('Jun 9, 2026, 08:28 AM'). Flagging as informational only.

ToolCard 'distance_km' km badge was not visible on /browse during this test run (logged-in admin viewing browse) — no km samples extracted. This may be because tools don't return distance_km when viewer has no geolocation OR is admin. Not a regression since the 'away' text removal is confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: dateFormat.js correctly handles the YYYY-MM-DD timezone trap via T00:00:00 suffix — verified no day-shift across all 3 locales.

formatDateRange falls back gracefully when Intl.DateTimeFormat.prototype.formatRange is unavailable; modern browsers used in tests support it natively (output uses narrow-no-break-space thin separators).
